<!doctype html>
<!-- A comment with <angle brackets> & an ampersand -->
<div class="wrap" data-json='{"a":1,"b":"&"}'>
	<pre><code>escaped </pre> inside a code sample</code></pre>
	<p>Literal close tag in a string: "</pre>" & "</div>"</p>
	<script>
		const gt = 1 > 0 && 2 < 3;
		document.title = "a & b";
	</script>
	<style>
		.wrap > p::after { content: " & more"; }
	</style>
</div>
